hooks.name: host_suite_noise_plane
hooks.basis: Fresh PF Handle Suite allocation, after lock and before generator writes any lattice elements. 0x942f calls allocation wrapper 0x9970; 0x943e locks via 0x98d0. Plane count is width*height in owner +0x10/+0x14.

hooks.name: host_suite_noise_table
hooks.basis: Fresh PF Handle Suite 404-byte allocation: owner+0x20=100; 0x9449 increments to 101; allocation at 0x944f and lock at 0x945e. All 101 floats must be written by 0x94d0..0x94f8 before sampling.
